Basic chat completion against real OpenAI API

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":10,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in exactly one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.usage())
```
